title: Faction Reputation Change Log
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=npc:ledger reputation_delta=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(reputation_delta) as net_reputation_change, count as updates by _time faction
| sort 0 _time faction
description: Trends how reputation with major factions rises or falls as the party makes decisions.
value: Faction reputation is a powerful campaign signal; seeing its history helps keep consequences coherent.
implementation: Ingest faction reputation deltas in `npc:ledger` and sum them monthly by faction.
visualization: Line chart of monthly reputation change by faction.
grandmaExplanation: It maps how your standing with each faction rises or falls as the group makes friends and enemies.
